# The Big Bloom: All Rewards

With thanks to the Young Coffee888

__Rewards for The Big Bloom__

Downloadable & Printable copies can be found __here__.

Flower Crown Crafting Calculator can be found __here__.

**Reward Checklist**

__Rewards__

This guide is broken into the following sections:

- Base Rewards
- Default Rewards
- Base Flowers
- Common Rewards
- Rare Rewards

Flower Crowns and Outfits can be traded after crafting by dropping them or placing them in Camp Vendors. However, they cannot be scrapped or sold to Robot Vendors.

__Base Rewards__

XP - 300 (base)

Caps - 100 (base)

Legendary Modules - 1

Murmrgh's Mystery Pick - 1x 3* item

Treasury Notes - 3

__Default Rewards__

100% chance for a Gamma Green Tea PLUS one of the following to drop:

**Gamma Green Tea**

Description: Harvest additional flowers (flowers only, not fruit) for 30 minutes

Susan's Floral Secrets unlocks the following craftable items at the Tinker's bench. These items are needed to craft some of the other flower crowns.

Hybrid Flower - Candykill

Hybrid Flower - Embergold

Hybrid Flower - Gigablossom

Hybrid Flower - Glorybell

Hybrid Flower - Green Invader

Hybrid Flower - Seesprout

Hybrid Flower - Starlace

**Player Title: Gardener**

Suffix

Drop Condition:

- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Carnal Weeper
- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Crystalcup
- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Radlily

Released: 2025

Non-Tradeable

Stops dropping once learned

__Base Flowers__

Used to craft Flower Crowns, Black-Eyed Susan's Soothin', and the Pot O' Camp Resources.

100% chance for one of the following to drop:

**Carnel Weeper**

5 to 10 flowers

**Crystalcup**

5 to 10 flowers

**Radlily**

5 to 10 flowers
